entries.name: Rallies won on serve
entries.definition: Of the rallies your side served, the share your side won.
entries.formula: rallies where winning_side = S and serving_side = S / rallies where serving_side = S

entries.name: Rallies won when receiving
entries.definition: Of the rallies the other side served, the share your side won.
entries.formula: rallies where winning_side = S and serving_side != S / rallies where serving_side != S
entries.source: QD §3.2 (coach judgment, UNVERIFIED); docs/domain/metric-dictionary.md v0.1; D-1 decided 2026-10-07 (UI name 'Rallies won when receiving', ADR 0044 rule 5)

entries.name: Points per service turn
entries.definition: On average, how many points your side scored each time it got the serve.
entries.formula: points scored by S while serving / service turns of S (a turn starts when S gains the serve or at the game start and ends at the side-out or the game end)

entries.name: Unforced errors per game
entries.definition: How many rallies per game ended with a mistake by your side that the other side did not force.
entries.formula: rallies with ending = unforced_error attributed to S / games in scope; per player only where responsible_player is tagged
entries.source: QD §3.2 (coach judgment, UNVERIFIED); docs/domain/metric-dictionary.md v0.1; open issue D-2 (forced vs unforced reliability, QD X3)

entries.name: Serve faults
entries.definition: Of your side's serves, the share that were faults.
entries.formula: rallies with ending = fault and fault_subtype = serve attributed to S while serving_side = S / rallies where serving_side = S; a lower bound when a serving-side fault has no subtype

entries.name: Longest scoring run
entries.definition: The most points your side scored in a row before the other side scored.
entries.formula: longest maximal sequence of points scored by S with no point by the other side; serve-only rallies do not break a run; runs reset at game end; histogram 1, 2, 3, 4, 5+

entries.name: How rallies ended
entries.definition: Of the rallies your side ended, how many were winners you hit, unforced errors, forced errors or faults.
entries.formula: for rallies whose ending is attributed to S: the share of winner, unforced_error, forced_error and fault (n = those rallies)
